facts.text: I paid a thousand dollars to sit at the cool table. Dinner tonight is cheaper, and the company's better.
facts.why: Ronald never says this. The quote page lists his real lines and none is about a cool table or dinner. It is printed in quote marks as his words. A note in his voice is true to the plot.
